speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are an adolescent with delayed menarche, unusual physical features, and a history of bone fragility. To narrow this down, have you noticed any specific facial characteristics like a prominent forehead or jaw, or issues with your vision?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (likely 21-hydroxylase deficiency) presenting with ambiguous genitalia at birth, virilization (hirsutism, severe acne), and potential bone density issues.

I am requesting further confirmation. REQUEST TEST: 17-hydroxyprogesterone level, ACTH stimulation test, and baseline electrolytes. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic ultrasound to evaluate for structural abnormalities.
